beats.text: France hits 99.8 percent for women with accounts. Yemen stops at 5.4 percent.
Yemen is the lowest on Earth. Pakistan has 11.9 percent and Niger has 12.2 percent.
This counts women who use a mobile money service or have a bank account.
Nigeria has 52.2 percent and Indonesia has 58 percent.
India and China both have 89.2 percent.
USA has 97.1 percent. UK has 99.3 percent.
France is the world's highest at 99.8 percent. It has 18 times the value Yemen has.
What would change if every woman had a bank account?
